The '''Andrevea River''' was a long [[Water/Legends|waterway]] that passed through several regions on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] before flowing into a [[Unidentified Naboo swamp|swamp]]. During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the river was the site of [[Attack on disabled base|several]] [[Liberation of enslavement camps|skirmishes]] between [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] and the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Ferentina]].

==Description==
The Andrevea River on [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] stretched from its source in the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] glacial regions<ref name="SW:BN" /> to the vicinity of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Ferentina]] before letting out into a [[Unidentified Naboo swamp|swamp]].<ref name="Ferentina">{{CSWECite|1|264|Ferentina}}</ref> A mainland river delta lay at one point along the [[Water/Legends|waterway]]. The banks of the Andrevea River featured varying terrain as it passed through different regions of Naboo. In the glacial regions, the river was bounded by ice and rocks, while the part of the river near Ferentina had steep banks with [[Grass/Legends|grass]] and beaches.<ref name="SW:BN" />

==History==
[[File:Lt._Gavyn_Sykes_Bravo_6_Headshot.jpg|thumb|left|185px|Gavyn Sykes traveled along the river on his way to liberate Naboo's enslavement camps.]]
During the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invasion]] of the planet in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Note">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]'' refers to its events taking place during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> launched against Naboo in response to [[Merchant/Legends|trade]] disputes,<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> the Federation established [[Slavery/Legends|enslavement]] camps for [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo citizens]] on the banks of the Andrevea River. In order to [[Liberation of enslavement camps|liberate]] the camps, [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] utilized a stolen [[Ostracoda-class gunboat|Federation gunboat]] to travel down the river from a [[Trade Federation base|destroyed Federation base]] at the river's source in Naboo's glacial regions to the river delta, where the camps had been established. Along the way, Sykes had to blast through a wall that blocked passage along the river at the edge of the Federation base. [[Gender/Legends|He]] also had to contend with water-based [[Mine/Legends|mines]] and Trade Federation patrols.<ref name="SW:BN" />

Upon releasing the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] from the enslavement camps, Sykes joined up with his [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmen]] and led a [[Naboo houseboat|convoy]] of the rescued civilians from the camps to Ferentina, where an ambush forced the convoy to continue on land and take [[Seraph-class urban landspeeder|Flash speeders]] while Sykes took an [[N-X Police Cruiser/Legends|N-X Police Cruiser]]. During the ambush, Ferentina was heavily damaged by [[Trade Federation droid bomber|Federation bombers]].<ref name="SW:BN" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Andrevea River appeared in the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]'' as the setting for two consecutive missions.<ref name="SW:BN" />
